history.summary: Charbhuja (also spelt Chaturbhuja), the four-armed form of Vishnu/Krishna, is widely worshipped in Rajasthan, the most famous shrine being the Garhbor temple in Rajsamand district. No published history, founding date or patron of the specific Charbhuja Mandir at Nagar Fort (Nagarfort), Tonk district, could be found online. name: Charbhuja Mandir, Nagarfort
town_description: Nagar Fort (Nagarfort) is a settlement in Deoli sub-district of Tonk district, south-eastern Rajasthan, with an old fort structure giving the place its name. Tonk district lies in the eastern Rajasthan plains, historically shaped by Rajput principalities, and is dotted with small Vishnu/Krishna shrines like the Charbhuja temples.
